entries.definition: The status assigned to a transaction that has been received, has passed all validity checks, but does not agree with information previously submitted from another supplier.
entries.other: The status assigned to a transaction that has been received and validated but is inconsistent with information already submitted by another supplier.

entries.definition: The status assigned to a transaction that has been received, has passed all validity checks, and exactly matches another transaction previously received from the same submitter.
The transaction has passed all of the mandatory edits.  Any field and record rejects, and status re possible duplicate works will be noted in messages.
The registration was accepted as submitted by the publisher and is now ready for payment
The registration was accepted but modifications were made e.g. CAE numbers supplied, OIP info corrected
The status assigned to a transaction that does not meet the editing requirements documented for that transaction type.  Publisher must resubmit.

The status assigned to indicate that the receiving society has no interest in the work, and therefore may not have edited the work fully e.g. if BMI received a work that contained only ASCAP interested parties (or vice versa)
The publisher's claim to this work is rejected.
The status assigned to a transaction that has been received and validated but where an interested party has formally disputed the registered rights or shares.
